tagline: 哈苏胶片单反相机，1971 年发布
description: 哈苏于1971年推出的胶片单反相机。配备The standard lens of this camera was Carl Zeiss Planar 80mm f/2.8。快门速度Synchro-Compur, central leaf shutter in the lens。使用120 roll, picture size: 6x6cm, or 6x4.5 format with special magazine。via Fresnel matte screen。

specs.胶片/画幅: 120 roll, picture size: 6x6cm, or 6x4.5 format with special magazine
specs.镜头: The standard lens of this camera was Carl Zeiss Planar 80mm f/2.8
specs.快门: Synchro-Compur, central leaf shutter in the lens
specs.曝光测光: aperture and speeds rings move together with the lock catch on the lens; 2-18 EV index, red scale numbers and locking catch on the lens; unlock the catch for manual settings
specs.卷片: dial on the right side of the camera
specs.取景器: Waist level finder, Fresnel lens and grainless ground-glass screen, w/central cross , w/ black lines for 6x4.5 format
specs.闪光灯: fully sync, on the lens, select M X V by the lever after moving the catch on the lens forward just beside it
specs.自拍: by M X V selector lever on the lens, set to V
specs.电池: two 3V Ni-Cad rechargeable battery (not manufacturing anymore), serial connection
specs.英文简介: The Hasselblad 500 EL/M is a medium format film SLR system camera with motor drive, manufactured by Victor Hasselblad Aktiebolag, Göteborg, Sweden, and produced between 1971-84.
